attachments.select: SELECT 'Accounts/' || account.ZIDENTIFIER || '/Media/' || media.ZIDENTIFIER || '/' || media.ZGENERATION1 || '/' || media.ZFILENAME FROM ZICCLOUDSYNCINGOBJECT AS media JOIN ZICCLOUDSYNCINGOBJECT AS account ON account.Z_PK = media.ZACCOUNT6 AND account.Z_ENT = (SELECT Z_ENT FROM Z_PRIMARYKEY WHERE Z_NAME = 'ICAccount') WHERE media.Z_ENT = (SELECT Z_ENT FROM Z_PRIMARYKEY WHERE Z_NAME = 'ICMedia') AND typeof(account.ZIDENTIFIER) = 'text' AND account.ZIDENTIFIER != '' AND instr(account.ZIDENTIFIER, '/') = 0 AND instr(account.ZIDENTIFIER, char(0)) = 0 AND typeof(media.ZIDENTIFIER) = 'text' AND media.ZIDENTIFIER != '' AND instr(media.ZIDENTIFIER, '/') = 0 AND instr(media.ZIDENTIFIER, char(0)) = 0 AND typeof(media.ZGENERATION1) = 'text' AND media.ZGENERATION1 != '' AND instr(media.ZGENERATION1, '/') = 0 AND instr(media.ZGENERATION1, char(0)) = 0 AND typeof(media.ZFILENAME) = 'text' AND media.ZFILENAME != '' AND instr(media.ZFILENAME, '/') = 0 AND instr(media.ZFILENAME, char(0)) = 0 ORDER BY media.Z_PK

tables.chosen: Z_ENT = (SELECT Z_ENT FROM Z_PRIMARYKEY WHERE Z_NAME = 'ICNote')
files: CASE WHEN Z_ENT = (SELECT Z_ENT FROM source.Z_PRIMARYKEY WHERE Z_NAME = 'ICMedia') THEN 'Accounts/' || (SELECT account.ZIDENTIFIER FROM source.ZICCLOUDSYNCINGOBJECT AS account WHERE account.Z_PK = ZICCLOUDSYNCINGOBJECT.ZACCOUNT6 AND account.Z_ENT = (SELECT Z_ENT FROM source.Z_PRIMARYKEY WHERE Z_NAME = 'ICAccount')) || '/Media/' || ZIDENTIFIER || '/' || ZGENERATION1 || '/' || ZFILENAME END
tables.keep: Z_ENT IS NOT (SELECT Z_ENT FROM Z_PRIMARYKEY WHERE Z_NAME = 'ICNote')
